Question: What is the best piece of advice you could give someone about life?
Answer: Last week, I was having lunch with my friends at a restaurant after we were done with our university work. We were simply cracking jokes and laughing that's when I realized something. I stopped laughing and I was just looking at my own reflection that I could see in the glass which was infront of me. I realized that - Life is nothing but moments. That jokes we cracked and laughed about were moments. Moments come and go. Life is all about moments. That fight you had with your best-friend, that whole night you stayed up for a project, that frightening moments before a interview, everything is just matter of few moments. Those days you spend talking to a guy you thought you would end up together was just a moment. That exam you failed, that race you never won, that presentation you messed up, that game you lost is a moment. Those nights when you cried to sleep, that phases of loneliness, that day when you were just crying aloud sitting on the floor, everything is moment. Every high and every low, every up and every down and everything in between is moments. You may remember these moments or you may even forget them. But you know what ? You will always remember the people you spent your moments with and the way you felt. The way she made you smile, the way she was a light in the darkness of your boring life, the way she was a cool breeze of air, that patch of happiness she was, the way she cared for you, the way she gave you all of her attention, the way she made you feel special, everything was a moment and it passed. All of these moments, people and the way they make us feel makes bigger moments called Life. All in all, life is the collection and combination of these moments. So, appreciate the moments you are given, and people with whom you share those moments, because no matter how happy or tragic a moment is eventually it will end. So, Hug a little tighter, Smile a little more curvier, Cry a little louder, Smile a little harder, Forgive a little quicker, Care a little more, Love a hell lot more deeper. Because these are the moments you will remember one day, when you will be sitting on your arm chair and will be counting days, these moments will come across as a flashback infront of your eyes, and only thing you would regret - I wish I could just go back and live a little more. You would want to rewind. Nothing lasts, everything passes, better enjoy it before it's gone. Hey, If you liked what you have read so far don't forget to hit that follow button. Question: What are you missing in your life?
Answer: A Guy…. A guy who will always be there for me. Who will push me to achieve my dreams. Who will hold my hand when it's difficult. Who will not leave when I am hard to deal with. I am 22 almost…. I have come across so many guyz, I have received many proposals, I never accepted any. I never found a guy who has that spark. Someone who can understand me. When it comes in person, I am really weird to deal with. I have created so many expectations in my minds for my guy and sometimes I feel I will be disappointed because I don't think someone exists the way I want him to be. I believe love is not something romantic or intimate though I am a hopeless romantic ;), I think love is friendship. Someone who understands you, someone who will be there for you even at your worst. Sometimes I wish I just want to know who will be my life partner, just tell me who is he and how he is exactly ? I never had a boyfriend, I am very much happy being single but you know sometimes I feel I am missing on something. Not many would agree on my statement but I believe - Your life actually starts after you meet or get your better half. Loving someone is so sacred and meaningful to me. I can't just get into relationships just for the sake of being in it or whatever. Someone who you can talk to everyday, with whom you can share anything and everything, someone who thinks of you when he goes to sleep, someone who prays for you, someone whom you can rely on blindly, with whom you can fall in love over and over again. Love is a beautiful and amazing feeling, though I was never in love but whenever I think of Love, I smile. It excites me and also scares me at the same time. Component of love is only missing in my life right now, I guess otherwise by God's grace I have everything. Rabiya 💫

Question: Can you share your 40 days study plan for your entrance exams?
Answer: I have received many requests to share my routine as to how I managed to study 13– 14hours and cracked the entrance exam. My routine some what looked like this - This was daily schedule. I have never been night owl earlier but one day I pulled an all nighter and messed up my daily routine, so I had to stick on the night study plan. I found it very peaceful to study at night because there were no disturbances around. Studying for such long hours that too continuously for many days can make you feel burned out but for me the incomplete syllabus always gave me that kick to study no matter what. I believe in the presence of god very heartfully and I usually planned my day around prayers , so that I don't miss any of them. Prayer is like a meditation and god is like a friend to me. Sometimes I used to cry sitting on the prayer mat because I used to feel very frustrated and helpless. Crying has always been therapeutic for me and it somehow gave me strength to push myself further. Having conversation with god made me feel calm and composed. It gave me a feeling that things are doable. Make sure you have a venting out system because you may need it. Be it God himself, a friend, a diary or whatever. Take all the stress out from your mind. There were times when I felt like giving up. There were time where things seemed very impossible to me but then they say - what doesn't kill you, makes you strong. I also got food poisoning and it wasted my three precious days and it disrupted my study plan but I picked myself up and kept going. Incorporate a fun element for yourself if possible. I daily used to watch one episode of my favorite show doubling the playback speed. I somehow managed to fit that in my schedule at the end of my big study session. You can personally tweak the schedule ofcourse according to your needs and routine. One advice - If you have plenty of time, take proper sleep and don't leave things for last minute. Don't procrastinate. Use your time wisely and take care of your physical and mental health. Just know your “WHY" and finding your “HOW” will not be too difficult. Wishing you all the good luck. Rabiya
